scope: Original selected memory process lifecycle only; capture, extraction/embedding and semantic functionality remain separate actual gates.

enablement.source: Actual root authenticated installer selected service enablement choice already describing exact provider/backend variant/private profile/namespace/service and fixed start operation. Same explicit enable choice records lifecycle purpose; no new repeated approval and no inferred choice from installed bytes, account login, capture consent or non-null handle.
enablement.registry: Existing root setup choice registry retains source observation; active publisher stores digest-covered memory service enablement selection linkage. RootMemoryServiceLifecycle resolves current selected enablement through root registry before start/restart, not through RootMemoryCaptureConsentRegistry. No separate capture prompt just to start service.
enablement.permissions: Finite start/status/stop/manual restart and selected bounded restart policy only, zero additional budget; no capture/history scan/extraction/embed/provider egress/account/model install or lazy download. Stop-owned cleanup remains available after revocation; new start/restart denied.

prestart.source: Exact active ProtectedEnrollmentCatalog process profile/operation recipe and ArtifactCatalog/runtime receipt getter; actual executable/member bytes re-opened nofollow, held file identities and digests verified; all child artifacts/config/engine/model resources referenced by selected recipe. Relative member paths resolved only through selected held roots; source archive hash never executable hash.
prestart.persistent_join: lifecycle_binding.prestart_receipt_handles refer to protected registry records retaining artifact closure selection, not expiring setup fetch handles. Active publisher validates selected closure and stores durable parent linkage; resolver issues fresh <=30s current snapshot under enclosing active generation and owner epoch. Record may survive setup, but signature alone cannot bypass changed artifacts/current generation/revocation. No prerequisite live setup authorization after activation.
prestart.missing: Legacy opaque handles without retained active artifact/recipe/config/runtime proof fail closed with exact missing artifact/selection, never promote arbitrary strings. No active row inserted merely to satisfy prestart; actual installed receipt producer and active publication remain required.

semantic_readiness.source: Execute only existing selected source-backed fixed readiness/capability routes through current managed namespace/process and bounded serializers. Bind actual request/result receipt handles and root validator schema/artifact identity; no caller boolean or status stdout promotes readiness.
semantic_readiness.readiness_kind: liveness|backend-semantic; consumers require exact needed kind
semantic_readiness.rule: OpenViking /ready and AgentMemory /agentmemory/livez remain process/backend status, never extraction/retrieval proof. Backend-semantic requires genuine existing selected remember/search or corresponding capability operations validated by exact provider protocol; fixture payload scoped to installer-owned isolated qualification namespace and authorized finite workflow, cleanup where actually supported. No fabricated route or unsupported deletion. If no source-backed semantic operation exists, backend-semantic remains unavailable with the exact missing operation.
semantic_readiness.privacy: No user transcript/history is a readiness fixture. Model/provider operations require actual independent private route/model deployment/consent and budget gate; service enablement is not that consent.
semantic_readiness.currentness: <=30s fresh snapshot and current selected process PIDFD/cgroup/profile/generation/namespace/owner/enablement. Process replacement revokes prior receipt; stop/start does not rewrite old immutable receipts.
